correctness.rationale: For fixed k, chi true on a of 2^k atom assignments, X_n~Bin(n,p) exactly. Conditioning Psi_0 is X_n>=ceil(n/2); w_n(j)=rho^j product_{ell<=j}(n-b_n-ell+1)/(b_n+ell), bounded by rho^j for p<1/2 and converging pointwise to rho^j. Dominated normalization gives total variation geometric excess with parameter rho; 2X_n-n=2J_n+(n mod2) gives even rho^ceil(h/2) versus odd rho^ceil((h-1)/2), distinct exactly for odd h. At p=1/2 central-binomial bound gives ratio->1, and p>1/2 follows from LLN. Independent exact rational binomial tail calculations through n=201 and h=1..6 checked the parity direction; sample p=1/4,h=3 trends toward 1/9 and 1/3. Does not assert arbitrary modal formulas.
